checks.label: Blog index hero section
checks.action: Add a premium hero section on blog index with clear value proposition.
checks.why: Hero hierarchy directly affects first-scroll retention.

checks.label: Blog keyword search form
checks.action: Expose search intent capture on blog index (query form).
checks.why: Search reduces bounce for high-intent visitors.

checks.label: Featured post card
checks.action: Add a featured article block above stream posts.
checks.why: Featured content guides attention toward best converting content.

checks.label: Quick category filters
checks.action: Add quick category chips near the hero section.
checks.why: Filter chips increase exploration depth and pages per session.

checks.label: Blog quality signal strip
checks.action: Add quality signal cards (sources, cadence, practical focus) to blog index.
checks.why: Trust indicators improve click-through to articles.

checks.label: Most popular sidebar
checks.action: Add a most-popular section in sidebar.
checks.why: Popular content shortcuts improve route-to-value for first-time users.

checks.label: Newsletter in blog sidebar
checks.action: Add compact newsletter capture to blog sidebar.

checks.label: Reading progress component
checks.action: Add reading progress bar for long-form post usability.
checks.why: Progress signals reduce abandonment on long pages.

checks.label: Post at-a-glance summary panel
checks.action: Add an at-a-glance panel in the post header.
checks.why: Fast skim context improves perceived clarity.

checks.label: Post metrics signal strip
checks.action: Add post metrics strip (sources, read effort, related depth).
checks.why: Visible evidence and structure builds editorial trust.

checks.label: Enhanced lead paragraph styling
checks.action: Style the lead paragraph to improve scannability and visual hierarchy.
checks.why: Strong opening typography increases time on page.

checks.label: Article table of contents
checks.action: Add sticky table of contents for long articles.
checks.why: TOC improves navigation and mobile return usage.

checks.label: References section with source labels
checks.action: Add structured references section with clear source labels.
checks.why: Source transparency improves trust and SEO quality signals.

checks.label: Reference domain pills
checks.action: Add domain pills to reference links for quick source recognition.
checks.why: Faster source scanning improves perceived authority.

checks.label: Recommended tools cards
checks.action: Keep recommended tools cards in article body with clear CTA hierarchy.
checks.why: Natural tool placement drives ethical affiliate clicks.

checks.label: Sticky conversion CTA
checks.action: Add sticky CTA at post level for conversion recapture.
checks.why: Sticky CTAs increase conversion without disrupting reading flow.

checks.label: Global design helper classes
checks.action: Define reusable CSS classes for blog signal cards and lead typography.
checks.why: Reusable tokens keep visual system consistent and scalable.
